Join: molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno, molecule_dictionary child on molregno, compound_structures on molregno, compound_records on molregno, activities on record_id, assays on assay_id, docs on doc_id, target_dictionary on tid. Filter: parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437', target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885', standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, activity_comment ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
